Bounds.description: The least and the greatest value a heuristic admits.

Check.description:
The check on a value: when `measure` passes `fails_above`, the value is
wrong.

fails_above.description: The measure above which the value is wrong.

measure.description: What the check measures, with the command that computes it.

source.description: The command that measures it, and how.

description:
`params/heuristic/v1`: how an agent derives one calibrated value, at
`/params/heuristics/<name>`. It names its inputs and its method, the
estimate the method starts from, the lenient default used without enough
data, the bounds a value must keep, and the check that says when the
value is wrong.

bounds.description: The least and the greatest value admitted.

check.description: The measure that says when the value is wrong.

consumer.description: The plugin that reads the value, such as `controls`.

default.description: The lenient value readers use without enough data.

enough.description: What counts as enough data to derive a value.

method.description: How to derive the value from the inputs.

recheck_after.description: The active days after which the value is due again.

start.description: The estimate the method starts from.

unit.description: The value's unit, such as `active-days` or `changed-lines`.

title: HeuristicRecord
